items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: I will say that I was working on a film score, “Good Shepherd” which was a film that Robert DeNiro directed... I had offered a suggestion to Mr. DeNiro... And it worked.

ctx.x: You’ve been a producer as well and I’m wondering if there’s been occasions where you’ve been an engineer with another producer and because of your experience you think this is not the way to go that this producer is suggesting. And do you ever butt heads? © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

No I don’t think so. I mean I’ve been fortunate enough to work with some really fine people. I will say that I was working on a film score, “Good Shepherd” which was a film that Robert DeNiro directed and there was a little piece in the film where — I don’t know if you’ve seen the movie but there’s this Russian possible double agent, possible spy defector, whatnot, they ask him to play some violin. Just you’re supposed to be this violinist, play something. And he was playing and we had this studio violinist just…
Are you aware or not if the band that the singers bring are usually their touring people? Or are they sort of picked for the show?
